recommendation: Keep the external-repo audit commit in core. If the work group still wants the FHIR-19564 extension, add recommendedFilename to HL7/fhir-extensions with context Attachment, type string, short/definition 'The recommended filename for an attachment', and the local-path/security usage note from the original application; otherwise record a work-group decision that the extension was intentionally retired while retaining the Attachment.title note.
issue_request: FHIR-19564 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification MnM change request asking where to represent the original filename for a CDA carried in DocumentReference.content.attachment. The approved resolution was to add a note to Attachment.title saying it may sometimes be derived from the source filename and to create a standard Attachment extension named recommendedFilename with local-path usage and security guidance.
initial_application: Commit 732b40c16876bd7f23e75b50253824d920485f4e, 'MnM changes for R5 + 1 vocab fix', mentioned FHIR-19564 and added the Attachment.title source-filename note in source/datatypes/attachment.xml. The same commit added source/datatypes/attachment-extensions-spreadsheet.xml with a recommendedFilename extension row on Attachment, type string, and the requested local-path/security notes.
additional_context: FHIR-19601 is a duplicate of the same filename question. Confluence minutes show FHIR-I reassigned the issue to MnM and MnM approved it as Persuasive with Mod 5-0-0. The current source/fhir.ini active profiles list has no attachment-extensions entry, and dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed the historical recommendedFilename row under the 'remove extensions from R5 source' refactor. Searches of the read-only HL7/fhir-extensions checkout found no current or historical recommendedFilename extension definition.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The active core datatype source already has the Attachment.title note, while the missing standard-extension artifact is outside the current core build scope and should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than by editing an out-of-build core spreadsheet.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-19601 asks where to record the filename of the original CDA file and was resolved as a duplicate of FHIR-19564.
